GoldenFloat with t27: one rule, seventeen float widths

It follows the AI numbers course. Every lesson opens a table drawn from one spec, next to that spec running in your browser; seven lessons are pending and say so.

Course 3, 27 lessons, one widget and one t27 spec each: the GoldenFloat family, where one rule built on phi splits every width from 4 to 1024 bits into sign, exponent and mantissa, then the same split with an exponent in trits.
